title: Social Surface Studies
description: Five independent studies translating the same hero concept into profile, chat, wheel, lobby, and unlock-style UI-facing assets.
creative_direction: These images do not rely on runtime references. Each one must independently restate the same heroine concept with enough clarity to survive sticker crops, radial UI, reward splashes, and social-share layouts.
